product_one_liner.value: Haptiq provides an AI-powered enterprise operations platform that unifies data, automates workflows, and surfaces decision-ready insights for private-equity firms, portfolio companies, and other large organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: Haptiq describes itself as an AI-native enterprise solutions company that centralizes data, automates workflows, and provides predictive insights for private equity, institutions, governments, and large operating environments; its homepage also characterizes the platform as AI-powered and serving companies and asset managers.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer link to products, clients, company, blog, FAQ, terms, privacy, and the DPA, with no pricing link. The contact page is a request/contact form rather than a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Haptiq homepage’s “Trusted by organizations like yours” logo wall displays the listed organization logos, supporting them as named customers. | named_customers.0: Nestlé appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.1: IBM appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.2: Sony Music appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.3: Procter & Gamble appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.4: PrecisionHawk appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.5: Electrolux Group appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.6: PointsBet appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.7: Silvur appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names. | named_customers.8: Red Hat appears among the company homepage customer/logo-wall names.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 343 employees, and a current company listing gives an employee range of 201–500; 343 falls within the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement identifies New York City as Haptiq’s headquarters location, including the 10 Grand Central address. | hq_country: Haptiq’s announcement describes its New York City headquarters as part of its U.S. presence, establishing the headquarters country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook identifies Haptiq’s founding year as 2009; the prior verified company-profile excerpt also gives 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is dominated by operations, industry, product-update, and marketing-oriented articles. Its visible technology/development items are not multiple engineer-authored accounts of how Haptiq builds its product; the homepage surfaces a lone systems-focused post, “Observability: The Secret to Building Reliable Software Systems.” This does not meet the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Haptiq links a public FAQ resource and its FAQ page contains many articles organized into sections including AI & Automation and Technology & Development. This functions as a multi-article public help/FAQ center, satisfying the stated docs criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Haptiq’s linked first-party job board shows “Empty Data” and says no jobs were found, while its careers site directs applicants to register interest if no suitable role is currently available. No current AI/ML/data-science opening is listed.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal DPA mentions SOC 2 Type II only as an example of an accepted audit framework, not as a claim that Haptiq holds the certification. Its privacy policy describes general safeguards but does not claim any of the listed certifications, so no certification is publicly claimed in these legal/security materials.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest identifiable financing entry is the April 2022 buyout; PitchBook classifies the latest deal type as Buyout/LBO and identifies the last financing date in April 2022. Tracxn has a conflicting “Unfunded” profile, so the selected deal classification is medium confidence. | funding_date: The Dealroom profile lists an April 2022 Buyout involving Pearl Street Equity, and PitchBook reports the last financing date as 2022-04-27. The requested YYYY-MM date is therefore 2022-04.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding/deal evidence is an April 2022 Buyout/LBO, well before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; no later round is shown in the reviewed funding profiles.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The linked first-party job board currently has no jobs listed and the careers site directs applicants to register interest when suitable roles are not available; it lists no SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Haptiq’s May 28, 2026 product-update post announces newly shipped Orion connectors and connection-management changes as well as a new Olympus compliance engine/dashboard. May 28 is within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small official leadership roster lists the CEO, CFO, CTO, VP of HR, and CPO. Searches for executive appointments/departures in the period did not surface a C-level or VP-level join or departure; a reported engineering director appointment is below the specified level. The roster itself does not provide tenure dates, so this is a medium-confidence negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Haptiq job postings name HubSpot and ActiveCampaign as marketing-operations tools and Salesforce or HubSpot as CRM platforms for sales and go-to-market work; these postings provide visible CRM and marketing-stack signals. | crm_stack_signal.0: Haptiq job descriptions name HubSpot among marketing automation/CRM tools. | crm_stack_signal.1: The marketing coordinator job description names ActiveCampaign as a marketing-operations tool option. | crm_stack_signal.2: The sales and go-to-market job description names Salesforce as a CRM platform.
